title: .curt conversation file (version 1)
description: Non-normative convenience schema for the .curt format. SPEC.md is normative; parseCurt in src/index.ts is the canonical validator. Unknown fields are intentionally unconstrained (see SPEC.md, "Unknown fields").

generator.description: Optional provenance. Validators must not depend on it.

createdAt.description: Epoch milliseconds; writers should emit integers.

updatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds; writers should emit integers.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds; writers should emit integers.
